meta.title: Hugo Is New at School
meta.textType: personal details and what I need

paragraphs: My name is Hugo, and I am eleven. Today is my first day at a new school. Everything here is new for me. I am a little afraid, but I smile. Teacher Nick says, "Hello, Hugo!" "What's your address?" he asks. "I live in the blue house near the market," I say. "What is your age?" he asks. "I'm eleven," I say. "Good," he says. "What do you need today?"

"I need a pencil and a book," I say. "I have nothing in my bag." Teacher Nick gives me a pencil and a book. Tom is in my class. He shows me my desk. Tom asks, "Do you like football?" "Yes, I do. I like it very much," I say. At break, I am hungry and thirsty. "I need a bottle of water," I say. "I have nothing to drink." "Come with me to the canteen," says Tom.

In the canteen, Tom shows me the menu on the wall. There is pasta, rice, and salad. "Which do you want?" asks the woman at the table. "I think I want pasta," I say. "Do you want a bowl of salad, too?" she asks. "No, thank you," I say. "I don't like salad." The woman gives me a bowl of pasta with red sauce. I eat my pasta, and it is very good. Tom says, "Now you know everything about our school." "Not everything," I say, "but I have a new friend."
